description: Land Title Settlement Department - Attiligoda South, Four Gravets Galle D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810017 (22/0787)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content is focused on land property matters, specifically title settlement and registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized administrative matters that would warrant classification under other types.
